name: The Gordunni Scroll
summary: A soiled scroll lies in the Gordunni Outpost, and picking it up shows what seems to be a meeting or ceremony. Rok Orhan at Camp Mojache would be interested in it, and in what it might mean for the Gordunni.

sections.title: The Soiled Scroll
sections.body: Taking up the soiled scroll, you see that it appears to depict a gathering or ceremony of some kind. Rok Orhan in Camp Mojache, you judge, would want to see it, and to learn what it might mean for the Gordunni.

faq.q: What does the Gordunni Scroll show?
faq.answer: It seems to show some sort of meeting or ceremony.

aliases: where do i take the scroll

faq.q: Where is the Gordunni Scroll found?
faq.answer: In the Gordunni Outpost, where you can pick it up.
The chain goes on with Dark Ceremony.
